structuralDecisions: All five continuation-class left-column candidates are linked to their preceding lexical article rather than counted as fresh starts.
The selected `Camarón` article starts at the bottom of the left column and continues with `Rio. Bacauri.` at the top of the right column before fresh R-001 `Camino vereda`.
Direct facsimile resolves L-018 `Calentura. Tabihueche.` and R-012 `Canto. Buica.` as exact visible articles; prior OCR tails are rejected as structural evidence.

Canonical R-030 contains two visible historical starts: `Carcoma de madera. Cuta-eumelam.` and detector-missed `Carbon. Matu.`; R-030 is therefore modeled as merged_articles and links both lexical objects.
Bottom `Car-` is confirmed as a catchword by direct comparison with p.150 opening `Carcel`; it is not a p.149 lexical start.
L-013 `Calcañar` retains one unresolved internal Cahita glyph rather than receiving a conjectural normalized form.
authorityGuards: All new ALC1737 readings in this pass derive from direct visual collation of the locally supplied 1737 witness.
BUE1890 is not used to supply or silently normalize any ALC1737 reading.
Direct AI-assisted collation is recorded as machine_corrected_unverified; humanVerified remains false.
The detector false negative `Carbon. Matu.` remains separately documented in p149_missed_visible_starts.jsonl after promotion.
An unresolved source glyph is preserved as explicit uncertainty rather than silently emended.

provenance.method: Exhaustive direct same-witness visual census followed by candidate/missed-start promotion and page-level closure; no independent human verification.
